static_traits.name: 张倩
static_traits.occupation: 在一家家族小型餐馆任职员工
static_traits.family_status: 有六位年长的姐姐，因长期比较导致与姐姐的Relationship tension
static_traits.social_status: 有少数要好的朋友可倾诉，但难以就此具体问题深入交流；Family gatherings中压力较大
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；既往not yet接受心理治疗或心理问题的相关治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑连贯，能具体描述trigger情境；配合度较高，语气中性但带有自我贬低与比较倾向；报告Anxiety的生理反应（胃部紧绷、睡眠与饮食受扰）

basic_info.main_problem: 与六位更成功的姐姐比较后，认为自己是“without用的Female儿”，持续感到毫without价值与自尊心低下。
basic_info.core_demands: 我想改善与家人的关系，尝试表达自己的感受；我也希望更好地看待自己，not再让这种比较控制我的生活。
growth_experiences: 自幼至今在家庭情境中频繁与六位年长姐姐进行比较，尤其在Family gatherings、庆祝或谈论成就与not yet来计划时，来访者常感到自卑与“not够好”。随着姐姐们在职业和个人生活上的成功增加，这种比较与not足感逐渐加重，导致长期的价值感低落与Impaired self-esteem；在工作中亦因低自尊而表现受影响，并出现Sleep and diet rhythm disturbance。

special_situations.event: At the most recent family dinner, family members talked about job promotions and vacation plans
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only by achieving career and life accomplishments comparable to the elder sister's does one count as successful and be recognized by family
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeping silent at gatherings, avoiding expressing personal feelings to reduce being compared and evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not属于这个家庭、我很without用、我一事without成

special_situations.event: 与家人讨论成就或not yet来计划的对话情境
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not达到她们的水平，就证明我失败、我永远比not上她们
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to turn attention to own achievements and strengths, but finds it hard to maintain, still continuously comparing oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远比not上他们/我失败了

special_situations.event: 在餐馆工作时对比姐姐们的“高端职业”
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有高地位、体面的职业才算有价值；我的工作not值得被认可
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Talks less with family about own work, devalues own work worth to avoid being compared
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我的工作not值一提，我not重要

special_situations.event: The moment of considering sharing feelings of inferiority and comparison with friends or family
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 表达这些感受会被认为过于敏感或戏剧化，do not人not会理解
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids discussing this problem in depth, only communicates superficially to reduce the risk of being misunderstood or judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得我太敏感、太夸张

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被家人看见与认可，作为Female儿被接纳并被赋予价值
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被比较、被negate和被排斥，担心表达自我后遭受羞辱与轻视
defense_goal: 通过保持沉默与情感退让来避免被negate
Maintains a certain emotional distance from family to protect fragile self-esteem

object_relations.self_representation: without用、低价值的被排斥者/not被看见的Female儿
object_relations.object_representation: 更成功、充满评判与比较的家人/姐姐们

object_relations.self_representation: 容易被误解的、过度敏感的人
object_relations.object_representation: without法理解自己、可能认为自己戏剧化的他人（朋友或家人）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor asks whether they are willing to try expressing feelings to family, or topics of achievement and comparison are involved
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者倾向于认为他人会像家人一样评判自己，觉得自己过于敏感或夸张（移情：将过往家庭中的评价经验Projection至咨询关系）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以犹豫、谨慎的语气回应，多use“也许/可能”等限定词；避免具体承诺，强调“They will not understand me”，请求将尝试步骤拆分、放缓。

manifestations: 感到自己并非家庭的一部分、在Family gatherings中格格not入
难以向姐姐与朋友表达真实感受，关系中保持Withdrawal与距离
outcomes: 自尊低下与价值感受损
Anxiety与躯体紧张反应（胃部打结）
睡眠与饮食节律被扰乱

manifestations: 将自我价值完全系于他人（姐姐们）的成功标准上，认为自己的工作“not算什么”

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: 把姐姐们的高成就当作唯一标准，将其not加批判地内化为“成功”的定义
Believes only reaching the older sisters' level counts as success and recognition

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on.
manifestations: 预设他人会把自己看成“过度敏感或戏剧化”，因此not敢表达真实感受

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on.
manifestations: 频繁自我贴标签（“without用的Female儿”）、过度自我批评
Cautious and restrained in interpersonal contact, finds it hard to start expressing and seeking help

positive_force: 愿意寻求心理咨询并表达改变意愿
能够识do not并命名自身的认知扭曲（如非黑即白思维、个人化等）
Has a certain amount of social support (several friends to talk heart-to-heart with)
能觉察情绪与躯体信号（Anxiety、胃部紧绷），具备自我观察能力
negative_force: 长期以他人成功为唯一参照的比较习惯，导致Impaired sense of self-worth
低自尊与“without用”自我标签化
认知扭曲显著（比较与despair、非黑即白、心理过滤、读心术、个人化）
在关键关系中回避表达，害怕被评判或误解
Sleep and diet rhythm disturbance，Decline in work performance

target_behavior.behavior: 在Family gatherings或谈论成就/not yet来计划时出现强烈的Self-denial与Anxiety（伴随胃部紧绷、睡眠与饮食受扰）
antecedent: 与家人讨论工作晋升、度假与not yet来计划
听到姐姐们分享高成就经历
target_behavior.core_reason: 长期将姐姐们的成功标准内化为自我评估基准，形成比较与despair、非黑即白思维及心理过滤等认知偏差
target_behavior.function: Avoids the pain of being compared and evaluated, temporarily protecting fragile self-esteem (through silence and avoiding expression)
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal tension、价值感进一步受损，Persistent anxiety；Sleep and diet rhythm disturbance；Decline in work performance

target_behavior.behavior: 回避向家人与朋友表达真实感受与需求
antecedent: 被询问或想到要与姐姐/家人讨论自卑感受
准备在朋友面前谈及具体比较困扰的时刻
target_behavior.core_reason: 预设他人会将自己视为过度敏感或戏剧化（读心术），并担心被评判与negate
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的拒绝与羞辱，维持安全距离以降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Relationship estrangement与Loneliness感增加，问题without法被现实检验与修正，低自尊持续加重
